featuredArticle.excerpt: The party fought its way out of the web canopy and into an execution. Remi swapped the crossbow for the musket and landed two direct hits through the smoke; Dan planted himself in front of everyone including Markop and turned the spiders with a mushroom-studded holy symbol; Eager and Dan killed the ettercap between them. The Iron Legion called for pest control, retreated, and then tried to arrest Archie mid-battle, which produced a temporary alliance nobody expects to hold. Markop called down divine favour, took a scythe to the skull, and split the Scorncrow's head open while it was on its knees asking a paladin for mercy. Remi, thrown clear by Mossy, found a breathing man with a red punch mark on his forehead and had the steel defender stand on his chest. Salam went down and did not get up.

latestUpdate.label: Latest Filing · Session Event
latestUpdate.excerpt: A button labelled EMERGENCY EXIT makes coffee — until the steam pops a ceiling vent, and the escape goes up instead of out. In the ducts: rats, echoes, and a blue light. Under it, Luigi — alive, alone, running security feeds and notes headed Wario's corruption. Darian's rolling-pin ambush is stopped by Alistair's hand; Evil Mario comes through the door in a cape of pixelated feathers; the studio plays Plumber Man and the corrupted Mario fights to the beat of the real Mario's own song. The floor collapses; studio-uniform paratroopas catch them; Darian orders a V and Luigi yanks the cape off. A tanuki leaf, a second Wario head, a flaming pipe, fire, a fire-alarm crawl, sprinklers, ice — and then one word: CUT. The whole production stops. Curtains. A reset break room. Wario walks in to applause from an empty house — and behind everyone comes a man in a director's cap Wario calls Boss, who knocks Wario out for ruining his show. Evil Mario points at the door he left through, and in a dark hallway Darian watches the Director pass carrying a folder and a small wired remote.

didYouKnow: ...that the Scorncrow told three separate filings it was not a monster, and when Remi Akamatsu finally tested the claim with a point-blank musket, the blood under the face was human?
...that Remi escaped two armed dungeon guards by drawing a goblin face on a cardboard box with a Sharpie marker and claiming to be a certified Box Guardian?
...that the Mount Ebott Survey Part VII file features Sans executing Flowey in a localized time-stop after recalling a midnight tea conversation with King Asgore?

editorialDirective.title: WAH! Editorial Directive — Time Filing Codes Are Now Mandatory:
editorialDirective.text: Eight filings say “30 Harvestide, 1040 BF” and not one of them says which came first. Waluigi is done guessing. Every new article now carries a filing code — TC:1040-08-30T23:50/SHD — year, month, day, the hour it happened, and which clock it happened on. The date you read stays in Waluigi's words. The code underneath it is checkable, and now something actually checks it. If you do not know the hour, you leave the hour off; you do NOT invent one. WAH!

campaignCovers.caption: The word that stopped the show. Darian — burned, soot-streaked, rolling pin still in hand — standing in the falling sprinkler water with the ice mid-advance behind him, and every weapon in the room going quiet…

fieldGallery.caption: The doorway, resolved: Hjumpik hauling Waluigi out by the sleeve while a second treant buds behind them.
After the compound rescue: Luigi's cap, clean bandages, and the note line that points toward the next arc.
The Scorncrow's mask knocked away — and a human face underneath it.
Inside the tree: the Skittering Grove, webbed boughs hung with wrapped shapes.
The grove at night: the Scorncrow's evil tree, bats at the roots, and Wario's stalled motorbike.
Eager's critical shortbow shot pins the Scorncrow at the feet.
A shambling mound eating the Overgrown Library, one volume at a time.
The red kitchen, where the cook's dinner makes the overgrowth wither.
Promo Mario's main stage — the clipping Waluigi is amending, loudly.
The Mario-shaped thing in the television, from the Revision 2 account.
Archie arrives on a thundercloud before the Tree of Woe.
The Dread Mansion corridor — the order nobody signed.
One object in an empty room: the axe, waiting, at the far end of the bridge.
Nine words, flatly placed: ‘Luigi... read it. Read the note. This changes everything.’
Empty blue overalls in the rubble — grinning with nobody inside.

historicalBackfills.title: The Assault on Bowser’s Throne Room — The Dragon at the Window
historicalBackfills.summary: The fake heir had already opened the throne room from inside when Fawthful’s dragon broke through its window and wall. Bowser ordered the garrison away from the dragon, preserved the survivors, and returned to confront the occupation.
historicalBackfills.caption: Second in the recovered sequence · throne-room breach and evacuation, not a present-day siege.

historicalBackfills.label: Historical Backfill · 2 Aethel, 1035 BF · The Debt Siege
historicalBackfills.title: The Debt Siege and the Sixty-Thirty Split — Wario's Claw and the Contract of Accord
historicalBackfills.summary: Two weeks after the Star Hill rescue, Wario brought a helicopter, a searchlight and a W-stamped mechanical claw to a billing dispute. Waluigi held his own study behind an ice wall, paid 150 gold down, and talked the siege into a signed 60/30 publishing accord — then the radio reported the clinic holding Luigi under lockdown.
historicalBackfills.caption: Mario's Disappearance Arc continues · a siege that ended in a signature, not a casualty list.
